implementation.vision_forward: embeddings(pixel_values) -> pre_layrnorm -> encoder.layers[0:12] -> CLS-only post_layernorm in the stock pooled path
implementation.embedding_forward: Conv2d(kernel=32,stride=32) -> flatten row-major -> prepend CLS -> add learned position embedding
implementation.hidden_state_indexing: encoder hidden_states[0] is the tensor after pre_layrnorm and before block 1; hidden_states[k] is after exactly k transformer blocks

L0.meaning: patch embedding plus learned positional embedding, after vision pre_layrnorm, immediately before transformer block 1

L12-pre.meaning: after transformer block 12 and before vision post_layernorm/projection

L12-postLN.meaning: patch-wise application of the checkpoint's frozen vision post layer norm

L12-proj.meaning: exact prior projected normalized patch baseline

excluded_tensor.raw_embedding_before_pre_layrnorm: audited and documented but not admitted as an eighth extraction candidate
excluded_tensor.reason: the fixed L0 candidate is the actual input to transformer block 1 and matches output_hidden_states[0]; adding both would violate the finite layer set

tokens.order: row-major 7x7 patch order inherited from Conv2d flatten(2).transpose(1,2)
tokens.persistence: float16 offline caches; probe arithmetic float32

forbidden: encoder gradient, LoRA, adapter, or fine-tuning
